exposure: untreated perinatal mood and anxiety disorders (PMADs)
outcome: excess cases of outcomes attributed to PMADs
cohort: The study modeled data for an average annual birth cohort in Vermont from 2018-2020, encompassing birthing parents and their children.
finding: The total societal cost of untreated PMADs in Vermont for an annual birth cohort from conception to five years postpartum was estimated to reach $48 million, amounting to $35,910 in excess societal costs per birthing parent with an untreated PMAD and their child.
